writing.title: Looking Back and Looking Ahead
writing.prompt_cn: 写一篇短文,回顾你的初中生活(用remember doing/used to/现在完成时),并展望高中或未来(用will/be going to)。60词左右。
key_points: 回顾初中难忘的事(I remember.../I used to...)
你这三年的变化(I have become...)
对高中或未来的计划(I will.../I'm going to...)
useful_expressions: I have become much better at ...
I will always be thankful to ...
writing.sample: As I look back at my three years in junior high, I have many happy memories. I remember meeting all my classmates in Grade 7. I used to be very shy, but now I have become much more confident. I have also made many good friends. Soon I will graduate and start senior high school. Things will be different, and the work will be harder. But I'm going to study hard and follow my dreams. I will always be thankful to my teachers and friends.

scoring.content: 含初中回顾/个人变化/未来计划/感受(4分)
scoring.language: 正确使用remember doing/used to/will/现在完成时(3分)
